summary: Golden in-process task suite (14 tasks over the real agent loop, real tools, temp workspace): read+answer, create, edit with diff, bash output reaches next request, bash failure fixed, 3 parallel tools, denied vs approved write, cancel in provider and in tool, kill mid-tool repaired on restart (wire carries the tool result), iteration cap and doom loop, retryable 503 retried, length-truncated turn runs no tools, model switch mid-session, project owner repairs dangling call on open. Found and fixed: project owners (remote host, project tabs) never answered dangling tool calls after a crash, so the next request sent an orphan tool_call that strict providers reject.
commands_run: cargo test --locked --all-features --no-fail-fast --test project_workspace --test headless_project_workspace --test tui_project_workspace --test remote_headless --test remote_headless_commands --test remote_worker_owner --test remote_workspace --test domain_execution_host --test headless_domain_owner --test core_session --test session_recovery
notes: Each task asserts files, journal reopen equality and request counts. Cancelling a side-effecting tool records an unknown outcome by design (resolved via resolve_tool_outcome); the task asserts exactly one. Doom-loop threshold is 5 identical calls. tests/support/scripted.rs gained Reply::Calls (in-process) and Reply::Overloaded (HTTP 503).
